title: A High-tech Farm
subtitle: 考点：科技与农业 / e-payment, digital, greenhouse
passage: Mr Li is the manager of a high-tech farm near a big city. The farm has many greenhouses, and the tomatoes grow there all year. Computers in each greenhouse check the heat and the water. Mr Li can even look at the plants on his phone.

The farm's products are popular. Customers order fruit on a website, and they pay with e-payment. A driver brings the fruit to their homes the same day. Mr Li says, 'Digital tools make our work easier. We need fewer workers, but the workers need to learn new skills.' Last year, the farm opened a small school, where villagers learn how to use computers.
